rmr.review:
Faculty review: Rmr (Dr. Mizanur Rahman)
Course: Geo205/Env207
One of the most friendly faculty. His lectures are well furnished. Teaches geography as he's telling stories to his kids. He's so down to earth that you ask any question regarding topic, he's very obliged to answer you 'till you get that. 
Techniques: since it's a Ged course, mostly students tend to get away with it. You're to attend his classes very seriously and take notes of everything he says.takes 2/3 quizzes and counts average. Takes one mid (sometimes two) and if one goes worst, there's a chance of improvement. Take his study tour seriously 'cause this contains 10% of your course. Write the paper with info. that you took from the tour and make a good presentation of it. That part goes with group. 
It's really easy to pull up a good grade if you follow up his instructions. Thank you!
Peace
